hero.heading: Build Your SaaS Application Faster
hero.subheading: A production-ready template with authentication, user management, admin panel, and tier system. Start building your unique features immediately.

authentication.title: Complete Authentication
authentication.description: Email-based registration, JWT tokens, password reset, and email confirmation built-in and ready to use.

userManagement.title: User Management
userManagement.description: Profile management, account settings, data export, and account deletion with full GDPR compliance.

adminPanel.title: Admin Panel
adminPanel.description: Manage users, roles, and system settings through a comprehensive admin interface with role-based access control.

productionReady.title: Production Ready
productionReady.description: Built with TypeScript, React, and Express. Includes Docker configuration for easy deployment.

tierSystem.title: Tier System
tierSystem.description: Built-in subscription tiers with usage tracking and limit enforcement. Perfect for SaaS pricing models.

notifications.title: Notification System
notifications.description: Banner and toast notifications with real-time updates via Server-Sent Events.

internationalization.title: Internationalization
internationalization.description: Multi-language support with i18next. English and German translations included.

taskScheduler.title: Task Scheduler
taskScheduler.description: Cron-based background task execution framework for periodic jobs and maintenance tasks.

securePrivate.title: Secure & Private
securePrivate.description: Industry-standard security with bcrypt password hashing, JWT authentication, and rate limiting.

cta.subheading: Get started with a solid foundation for your SaaS application
